headline: Europe Natural Gas Prices Hit Four-Year High Amid Supply Concerns
summary: European benchmark natural gas prices rose to $107.40 at the Dutch Title Transfer Facility, extending recent gains as winter approaches and LNG flows from Qatar remain constrained.
why: Energy costs are a critical driver of industrial production expenses and overall inflation across the European Union.

impacts.name: European Utilities
impacts.why: Higher wholesale gas prices increase input costs for utilities and heavy industry.

why_moved: Growing scarcity concerns ahead of winter and constrained liquefied natural gas supply create upward price pressure in commodity markets.
